items.title: 63475_Arnett Cobb oral history interview
items.q: the apartment that we had at 498 West 159th, Laverne and Joe got it for us.

ctx.x: But Joe Thomas would tell you everything he knew. So I had a double situation there with Joe -- loved his playing, his showmanship, plus he would talk to you and tell you things. So to me, he was like a father. And we ended up being very good friends, and when I got to New York -- well, I was with Lionel Hampton and he was with Luntz Ford, and they got married here in Philadelphia, and I was supposed to be his best man, because I was working at Fay's Theatre and had a break and couldn't get there and I sent my…

And when we got to New York, the apartment that we had at 498 West 159th, Laverne and Joe got it for us. Right around the corner from them. How it happened, their good friend -- her husband had gone in the marines, and they had

been in for awhile, and she didn't know if he was coming back or not, and she's just getting to the point where she didn't like it there and she decided to move back with her mother and give the apartment up.
